notes: Discontinued product (confirmed on linkelectronics.com/support/resources/discontinued-products). It is a 1U rack-mount closed-caption encoder/decoder/data-recovery unit for SD-SDI and analog composite/Y-C(S-Video)/component/RGB video (NTSC/PAL), not a display/switcher/AV-source in the usual sense — mapped to category "converter" / type "Encoder/Decoder" as the closest fit. Physical I/O and rack/power specs are drawn from Link Electronics' own instruction manual and spec sheet (mirrored on ManualsLib, since linkelectronics.com no longer hosts the doc) plus confirmed via B&H/Markertek/Adorama listings. The manual's rear-panel section describes connections via a color-coded wiring diagram rather than a plain connector list, so exact silkscreen labels (e.g. whether it reads "VIDEO IN" vs "ANALOG IN") are reconstructed, not verbatim. Spec-sheet totals (13 BNC, 2 mini-DIN, 1 XLR, 1 3.5mm, 2x 9-pin D-sub, 1 RJ11, 1 USB-B) were cross-checked against the wiring-diagram text and add up consistently across the 22 ports listed. SDI is confirmed SD-only (SD-SDI), so grade sdi-sd was applied only to the three digital/SDI BNCs; no HD-SDI support. Three connector types had no exact match in the allowed id list and were mapped to the closest one with an inline note: S-Video mini-DIN → midi-din, mono 3.5mm GPI jack → trs-3.5, RJ11 modem jack → rj45. Confidence set to medium because the source is authoritative (manufacturer's own manual/specs) but several exact panel labels and the precise routing of the two S-Video mini-DIN jacks (which is in/out) are inferred rather than directly confirmed from a rear-panel photo/diagram.
